latin_incipit: Corpus Christi est realiter et vere in sacramento, etiamsi panis non convertatur in corpus Christi, dummodo paneitas tollatur

english_translation.text: The body of Christ is really and truly in the sacrament, even if the bread is not converted into Christ's body, provided that breadness is taken away

exegesis: Pico's conclusion on Divine Embodiment within the Condemned Propositions tradition.
defense: Contains profound theological truth requiring proper interpretation
